After each guess, a black peg for each colour right and in place, a white one for each colour right but elsewhere. Duplicate colours on or off, input with the mouse or keys 1 to 6, and statistics: wins, average tries, best game. Expert mode (5 holes, 8 colours), raised pegs and key pegs set down with a little sound, gamepad, fullscreen, fits any screen size. Deduction game: find the code of 4 colours (out of 6) in 10 tries. After each guess, a black peg for each right colour in the right place, a white one for each right colour elsewhere. Reverse mode: the computer guesses your code with Knuth's method (5 guesses at most) while showing the codes still possible, plus a help option that counts them in your games. Duplicate colours or not, expert mode (5 holes, 8 colours), stats, gamepad, full screen.
